resources.string:
In short: every few hours the app checks whether VPN servers open from your network and sends the result, your carrier name and approximate area to the organizer. Your traffic, phone number, IMEI, contacts, SMS and app list are never sent.

In detail. On the schedule of the center (the organizer's server) the app sends: which carrier, which network type (LTE or Wi-Fi), the external IP address of the network, phone model and app version, which servers and sites responded and how fast, whether a VPN is active on the phone, a technical code for notifications (so the center can reach the app), and the app error log if something fails.

The app keeps a constant background connection to the center to receive commands quickly (a notification is shown, about 1 MB of data per day). App updates are downloaded automatically only over Wi-Fi (on request from the center - over any network) and are installed only after you tap.

On request from the center: diagnostics (battery, signal, SIM state, background restrictions), a check of a site or of the whitelist block page, a technical log for one server, a one-time precise location point - only if you have already allowed precise location, it is sent without rounding - and a speed test of about 8 MB.

It does not send: your phone number, IMEI, contacts, SMS, browser history, traffic content, or list of apps.

To detect your region correctly, the app will ask for approximate location (by cell towers, no GPS). Coordinates are rounded (to ~500 m by default) and are taken only while the app is open. You can refuse - then the region is detected by IP.

A regular check takes a few minutes and uses about 0.5-1.5 MB of data (more servers - more data). You can turn it off at any time with the button in the app or by uninstalling it.
⚠️ To keep checks running on their own, allow the app to work in the background: Settings → Apps → VPNCheck Agent → Battery → \"Unrestricted\", and turn on \"Autostart\" if your phone has it.
